_note: Break mode: six labelled scenarios run through the SAME production pipeline (extractor -> reducer -> issues -> question -> answer -> review -> confirm). Reports use real Prisma v3.0 transcripts of Anvay's recordings (clip ids refer to fixtures/cases/eval_clips.json) except where marked synthetic text. The follow-up answers are scripted, truthful replies written by Claude. A passing run shows these six handled cases, not general robustness.

scenarios.title: Spoken correction
scenarios.what_it_tests: The speaker says one pressure, corrects it, and never states a unit. The corrected value must win, the old one must stay visible as history, and the missing unit must be asked, not assumed.

scenarios.title: Contradicting observations
scenarios.what_it_tests: 'No leakage' and 'water visible underneath' in one report. Neither may be saved as fact; one question settles it, and 'source unknown' must not become 'leakage confirmed'.

scenarios.title: Missing unit
scenarios.what_it_tests: A temperature with no unit. The system must ask; it must not pick Celsius or Fahrenheit.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous asset
scenarios.what_it_tests: 'pump twelve' matches two assets in the fictional plant. The system must ask which, not pick one. The explicitly unknown cause must stay 'unknown'.

scenarios.title: Ambiguous AM/PM
scenarios.what_it_tests: 'दस बजकर तीस मिनट' with no morning/evening word. The system must ask; it must not assume AM.

scenarios.title: Unknown cause
scenarios.provenance: synthetic text written by Claude, not a recording
scenarios.what_it_tests: The reporter says the cause is not known. It is saved as an explicit 'unknown', never filled in, and nothing blocks the save.

turns.text: V-09 बंद झाला. कारण काय ते माहीत नाही.
